fixes.what: The correction keeps Cliopatria's removal of about 330 Jämtland, Härjedalen and Idre-Särna cells (612,437 to 567,507 km2) for 1564-1569. No ledger event moves that land; there is only the 1563-1570 contest (/ledger/3, /ledger/4). In 1629 (contest kept in the owner's base) and 1713-1720 (occupations removed from the occupier's base) the dossier follows the owner-keeps-the-base convention, and this keyframe does not.
fixes.why: K2 note quotes the Northern Seven Years' War page: Sweden 're-occupied Jemtland, as well as Herjedalen and Trøndelag' in 1564, 'returned to Denmark-Norway in 1570'. Schema: occupation_start means the occupier holds 'region' belonging to 'counterpart' without annexing it, and the owner records the same event with the roles reversed. Älvsborg (3 Swedish cells, captured 1563, ransomed after Stettin) sits in the Danish base 1564-1571 with no occupation event.
fixes.fix: Choose one. (a) Make the correction the 1564 shape plus Jämtland/Härjedalen/Idre-Särna, minus the Älvsborg cells, then add occupation_start 1564 / occupation_end 1570-12 (counterpart kingdom-of-sweden) for Jämtland-Härjedalen and an Älvsborg occupation pair (Denmark occupies, 1563 to 1571). (b) Keep the shape and state in the note that the contest blend stands in for the occupation. Not blocking: the contest zone already covers the land in those years.
